· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($34,205/$36,505): below long-term trends, in a weak zone.
· 52-week position (31.6%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.7→35.6) + entered oversold territory + continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-60.8130→-101.8213) + confirmed worsening + weak trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower $22,142) + approaching lower band, band width at 39.70% level.

· Swing support ($23,100) + same level as 5-day low, requires support confirmation.
· Swing resistance ($24,575) + first resistance zone on short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (26,310/22,855, 33,675/22,855): no Higher Low confirmed, range-bound.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.29x) + movement has momentum, direction confirmation needed.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + consider buying on confirmation of $23,100 support, strengthen buy on breaking $24,575 resistance.
